title: XpSearchIngestionContract
description: Wire contract for the Xperience Search ingestion API (spec 10.1 - 10.4, 10.6, as amended by ADR-0010: documents are addressed by id, timings are tookMs). This schema is the single source of truth: the C# DTOs (XpSearch.Ingestion.Contract) and the TypeScript types are generated from it and must never be hand-edited. Endpoints, all under /api/xpsearch/admin/ and all authenticated with a Bearer API key (spec 10.4): POST indexes/{index}/documents (UpsertRequest -> UpsertResponse), PATCH indexes/{index}/documents/{id} (PatchRequest -> UpsertResponse), DELETE indexes/{index}/documents/{id} (-> DeleteResponse), POST indexes/{index}/documents/delete (BatchDeleteRequest -> DeleteResponse), POST indexes/{index}/clear (-> DeleteResponse), POST indexes/{index}/rebuild (-> UpsertResponse with taskId), GET indexes/{index}/status (-> IndexStatus), GET indexes (-> IndexListResponse). Every response carries the header X-XpSearch-Api-Version: 1. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details as produced by ASP.NET Core and are deliberately not redefined here; per-document failures are not errors of the request and come back in UpsertResponse.errors.

upsertRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits UpsertRequest. Never sent on the wire.

patchRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits PatchRequest. Never sent on the wire.

upsertResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits UpsertResponse. Never sent on the wire.

batchDeleteRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits BatchDeleteRequest. Never sent on the wire.

deleteResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits DeleteResponse. Never sent on the wire.

indexStatus.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits IndexStatus. Never sent on the wire.

indexListResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits IndexListResponse. Never sent on the wire.

UpsertRequest.title: UpsertRequest
UpsertRequest.description: Body of POST /api/xpsearch/admin/indexes/{index}/documents. Upsert, not insert: a document whose id already exists is replaced. Capped at 1000 documents or 10 MB per request; a larger request is answered with 413 rather than truncated.

documents.description: The documents to write. Must contain at least one document.

waitForIndex.description: When true the response is not sent until the write is searchable. Defaults to false, which queues the write on a background thread. A foot-gun for bulk imports: it serializes the caller against index writes.

PushDocument.title: PushDocument
PushDocument.description: One document to write. Open by design: every property other than id and _source is an attribute, validated against the index schema (spec 10.3).

id.description: Required, caller-owned and stable. Re-pushing the same id replaces the document.

_source.description: Reserved: the document's provenance. Defaults to the source of the API key, or to "external". Never "xperience", which is reserved for content the Lucene integration indexes.

PatchRequest.title: PatchRequest
PatchRequest.description: Body of PATCH /api/xpsearch/admin/indexes/{index}/documents/{id}: the attributes to change and nothing else. Applied as read-modify-rewrite over the stored document, because Lucene has no in-place update.

_source.description: Reserved: the document's provenance. Present only to keep the reserved name out of the attributes; changing it is rejected.

UpsertResponse.title: UpsertResponse
UpsertResponse.description: Answer to a write. A partially failed batch is still a 200: the documents that validated are written and the rest are reported in errors.

indexed.description: Number of documents accepted and persisted.

failed.description: Number of documents rejected by schema validation.

errors.description: One entry per rejected document, keyed by its id and the offending field.

taskId.description: Identifier of the queued write, present when the write was not awaited. Poll GET indexes/{index}/status to see it land.

id.description: The document's id, absent only when the document had none.

field.description: The attribute the error belongs to, absent for document-level errors.

BatchDeleteRequest.title: BatchDeleteRequest
BatchDeleteRequest.description: Body of POST /api/xpsearch/admin/indexes/{index}/documents/delete. Exactly one of ids and filter must be present.

filter.description: Delete every document matching the filter instead of naming ids.

DeleteFilter.title: DeleteFilter
DeleteFilter.description: Which documents a filtered delete removes. Only provenance is filterable: a delete that could match Xperience content would be a way to lose it.

source.description: Delete every document pushed under this source. "xperience" is rejected.

DeleteResponse.title: DeleteResponse
DeleteResponse.description: Answer to a delete or a clear.

deleted.description: Number of stored documents the operation removed.

taskId.description: Identifier of the queued write, present when the delete was not awaited.

documents.description: How many documents the index holds, and where they came from.

lastWrite.description: When an external document was last written to this index, absent when none ever was.

health.description: "healthy" when the index is readable and no write has failed - including while queued writes are still waiting, which is the normal state of an asynchronous write, "degraded" when queued work failed to reach the index and nothing has succeeded since, "unavailable" when the index cannot be read.

total.description: Number of documents in the Lucene index, whatever their provenance.

bySource.description: Number of documents per _source value, including "xperience".

additionalProperties.description: Number of documents carrying the source.

indexes.description: Every registered index and the schema pushed documents are validated against.

schema.description: The fields the index accepts, detected from Xperience content types and declared in code.

allowDynamicFields.description: Whether a pushed document may carry attributes the schema does not declare. False by default.

SchemaField.title: SchemaField
SchemaField.description: One field of an index schema (spec 10.3).

name.description: Attribute name, as it appears on a pushed document and in a query.

type.description: What the field holds: "string" is matched verbatim, "text" is analyzed free text, "date" is Unix epoch seconds, "string[]" is a multi-valued facet dimension (an Xperience taxonomy).

searchable.description: Whether free-text queries match against the field.

facetable.description: Whether the field can be filtered on with filters.facets.

sortable.description: Whether the field can be used as a sort key.

retrievable.description: Whether the field is stored and can be returned in a result's attributes.
